text.en:
The sum of twenty-five thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as aid to the Philippine
Amateur Athletic Federation for the promotion of athletics and/or athletic competition in the schools and other
civic institutions of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1936.
